units.source_text: 此寺位在北山深处。

en.t: This temple stood deep in the northern hills.

units.source_text: 时值三月下旬，京中花事已经阑珊，山中樱花还是盛开。

en.t: It was late in the third month; in the capital the blossoms were already fading, but in the mountains the cherry trees were still in full bloom.

units.source_text: 入山渐深，但见春云叆叇，妍丽可爱。

en.t: As they went deeper into the hills, only the spring clouds could be seen drifting thickly, beautiful and charming.

units.source_text: 源氏公子生长深宫，难得看到此种景色，

en.t: Prince Genji had grown up deep within the palace and rarely had the chance to see scenery like this,

units.source_text: 又因身份高贵，不便步行远出，所以更加觉得珍奇。

en.t: and because his noble rank made it inconvenient for him to walk far from home, he found it all the more rare and marvelous.

units.source_text: 这寺院所在之地，形势十分优胜：

en.t: The site where this temple stood was exceptionally fine in its natural setting:

units.source_text: 背后高峰矗天，四周岩石环峙。

en.t: behind it high peaks rose into the sky, and on every side rocks stood encircling it.

units.source_text: 那老和尚就住在这里面。

en.t: The old monk lived there within it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子走进寺内，并不说出姓名，装束也十分简朴。

en.t: Prince Genji entered the temple without giving his name, and his clothing was very plain as well.

units.source_text: 然而他的高贵风采瞒不过人，

en.t: Yet his noble bearing could not be hidden from anyone,

units.source_text: 那老和尚一见，吃惊地说：

en.t: and when the old monk saw him, he said in surprise:

units.source_text: “这定是昨天召唤的那位公子了。

en.t: This must be the young lord who was summoned yesterday.

units.source_text: 有劳大驾，真不敢当！

en.t: To have troubled Your Grace to come here is truly more than I deserve!

units.source_text: 贫僧今已脱离尘世，

en.t: This poor monk has now withdrawn from the world,

units.source_text: 符咒祈祷之事，早已遗忘，

en.t: and matters of talismans, spells, and prayers have long since slipped from my memory,

units.source_text: 何劳屈尊远临？”

en.t: so why should you lower yourself to come such a long way?

units.source_text: 说着，笑容满面地看着源氏公子。

en.t: As he spoke, he looked at Prince Genji with a face full of smiles.

units.source_text: 这真是一位道行极高的圣僧。

en.t: He was truly a holy monk of very deep spiritual attainment.

units.source_text: 他便画符，请公子吞饮，又为诵经祈祷。

en.t: He then drew a talisman and had the prince swallow it in drink, and also chanted sutras and prayed for him.

units.source_text: 此时太阳已经高升，源氏公子便步出寺外，眺望四周景色。

en.t: By then the sun had already risen high, so Prince Genji stepped outside the temple and gazed at the scenery all around.

units.source_text: 这里地势甚高，俯瞰各处僧寺，历历在目。

en.t: The ground here was very high, and the temples of the monks below could be seen clearly in every direction.

units.source_text: 附近一条曲折的坡道下面，有一所屋宇，

en.t: Below a winding slope nearby stood a residence,

units.source_text: 也同这里一样围着茅垣，

en.t: also enclosed, like this place, by a fence of thatch,

units.source_text: 然而样子十分清洁，

en.t: yet its appearance was very clean and pure,

units.source_text: 内有齐整的房屋和回廊，

en.t: with well-ordered buildings and corridors inside,

units.source_text: 庭中树木也颇饶风趣。

en.t: and the trees in the garden also had considerable charm.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便问：“这是谁住的屋子？”

en.t: Prince Genji then asked, Who lives in that house?

units.source_text: 随从人答道：“公子所认识的那位僧都，

en.t: An attendant answered, The bishop whom Your Lordship knows

units.source_text: 就住在这里，已经住了两年了。”

en.t: lives here, and has already lived here for two years.

units.source_text: 公子说：“原来是有涵养的高僧居住之处，

en.t: The prince said, So this is the dwelling of a cultivated and eminent monk;

units.source_text: 我这微行太不成样子啊。

en.t: my secret outing is much too poorly arranged.

units.source_text: 也许他已经知道我到此了。”

en.t: Perhaps he already knows that I have come here.

units.source_text: 但见这屋子里走出好几个很清秀的童男童女来，

en.t: Then several very pretty boys and girls came out of the house,

units.source_text: 有的汲净水[\[2\]](#part1334.html#m2)，有的采花，都看得清楚。

en.t: some drawing pure water[\[2\]](#part1334.html#m2), others picking flowers, and all of them could be seen clearly.

units.source_text: 随从人相与闲谈：“那里有女人呢。

en.t: The attendants chatted among themselves: There are women there.

units.source_text: 僧都不会养着女人吧。

en.t: Surely the bishop would not be keeping women there.

units.source_text: 这些到底是什么人？”

en.t: Who on earth are these people?

units.source_text: 有的走下去窥探，回来报道：

en.t: One of them went down to spy it out, then returned and reported:

units.source_text: “里面有漂亮的年轻女人和女童。”

en.t: Inside there are beautiful young women and little girls.
